description_en: You can retrieve a list of VSC mount target information
kebab_example: aliyun dfs describe-vsc-mount-points --input-region-id cn-hangzhou --mount-point-id f-037cb49e1d-c0000.dfs.aliyuncs.com --file-system-id e389e5c7-bcb4-4558-846a-e5afc4440000 --vsc-id vsc-asjodjoio0000 --status NORMAL --instance-id i-bp1g6zv0ce8oghu70000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVscMountPoints

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VSC to which the Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) is mounted
parameters.help_zh: 已挂载HDFS文件系统的VSC ID
parameters.name: vsc_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the ECS instance to which the HDFS file system is mounted.

Valid values:

NORMAL: The file system is mounted.

CREATING: The file system is being mounted.

INVALID: The file system failed to be mounted.

OK: Returns instances in the NORMAL, CREATING, and INVALID states
parameters.help_zh:
已挂载HDFS文件系统的ECS实例状态。

取值：
NORMAL ： 挂载成功。
CREATING：挂载中。
INVALID：挂载失败。
OK：可查询到NORMAL、CREATING、INVALID三个状态的实例
parameters.name: status
